meta.name: google-ads
meta.description: Manage Google Ads — performance, keywords, bids, budgets, negatives, campaigns, ads, search terms, QS, location targeting, bulk operations, experiments, asset management, portfolio bidding, offline conversions. Use for any mention of Google Ads, CPA, ROAS, ad spend, or campaign settings.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理谷歌广告投放与优化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责谷歌广告账户的日常管理与效果提升。
copy.tagline_en: Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Google Ads accounts and want to improve performance.

howto.what: 装了之后,Claude 能直接读写你的 Google Ads 账户:查广告表现、改出价和预算、增删关键词与否定词、新建或暂停广告系列、做实验,并能在 7 天内撤销自己改动的操作。
howto.when: 当你提到 Google Ads、CPA/ROAS 等投放词,或要求查看、修改广告系列、关键词、出价等账户设置时触发。

say.text: 看看这周的 CPA 和上周比有什么变化
say.note: 对比两周指标并解释变动原因

say.text: 把搜索词里转化高的词加为关键词
say.note: 筛选搜索词后批量添加关键词

say.text: 检查这几天的改动影响,回滚有问题的操作
say.note: 查看改动影响并在 7 天内撤销

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude can read and write your Google Ads account via MCP tools: query performance, adjust bids and budgets, add/remove keywords and negatives, create or pause campaigns, run experiments, and undo its own changes within 7 days.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Google Ads, CPA/ROAS, or ask to view or modify campaigns, keywords, bids, or other account settings.

say_en.text: How did this week's CPA compare to last week?
say_en.note: Compares the two periods and explains the change.

say_en.text: Add high-converting search terms as keywords.
say_en.note: Filters search terms and bulk-adds keywords.

say_en.text: Check the impact of my recent changes and roll back problematic ones.
say_en.note: Reviews impact and undoes changes within 7 days.
